scope: C5 existing installed environment; source-only Git publication; NOT full native SBOM or binary redistribution approval

method.closure: PEP508 Requires-Dist traversal from15 requirements, markers evaluated on Windows CPython3.12, extras propagated including uvicorn[standard]. Tests are included because requirements.txt declares them.
method.advisories: PyPI exact-version JSON plus OSV querybatch PyPI/name/version for all80 distributions; no scanner installed. The feeds share OSV data and are not independent databases.
method.hashes: SHA256 over actual installed native/metadata/notice bytes. The retained inventory arrays preserve 175 native RECORD-derived rows for 174 unique normalized physical paths and 400 metadata/notice rows for 395 unique paths. All 174 unique native files have a matching installed RECORD SHA256. The ormsgpack slash/backslash duplicate includes one unhashed row and one matching hashed row for the same file. RECORD is not a publisher attestation. Matching PyPI wheel metadata is fetched but original wheel bytes are not downloaded or compared.
method.native_versions: PE VersionInfo and retained C2 static byte inspection; SSL and SQLite expose stdlib versions. No ASR/CT2/AV/native model imports or inference.
method.licensing: Package metadata labels are declarations, not full licence clearance. Existing C2 notices and proprietary/copyleft residuals retained.
method.publication: No installed binary, wheel, venv or model is copied into tracked candidate. Final frozen Git publication manifest belongs to gate acceptance.
